lines.t:
A setting for how long each <c:ffff00>charge<c> lasts. You
choose from 3 types:
  - {{short}} (brief): <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> +10%
  - {{normal}} (medium): {{charge_gauge}} +20%
  - {{long}} (lengthy): {{charge_gauge}} +50%

Per unit of time, the {{charge_gauge}} rises more in
this order: {{long}} > {{normal}} > {{short}}.
(The longer it is, the more efficient the charge)
